description: This file defines a singleton class 'AgentEventStore' responsible for managing a collection of 'ControlAgentEvent' objects. It provides methods to append new events, maintaining a maximum limit, and to clear all stored events.

classes.name: AgentEventStore
classes.description: A singleton class that manages a collection of control agent events with methods to add and clear events.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds an event to the store and removes oldest events if the maximum limit is exceeded.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all events from the store.
